tools.name: quoter_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes with their name, status, draft flag, email status, contact and totals. Filter by draft flag, status, email status, name, custom number or creation date. Quoter API: GET /quotes.

tools.name: quoter_create_quote
tools.description: Create a new quote for a contact from a quote template. Creates a record in the account. Quoter API: POST /quotes.

tools.name: quoter_add_line_item
tools.description: Add one line item (a product or service with quantity and prices) to an existing quote. Quoter API: POST /line_items.

tools.name: quoter_list_contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts with name, organization, email, phone and billing address. Filter by email, city, country or region. Quoter API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: quoter_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with name, organization, email, phone, billing and shipping address. Quoter API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: quoter_create_contact
tools.description: Create a customer contact. Email, first name, last name, organization and billing country are required by Quoter. Quoter API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: quoter_update_contact
tools.description: Change some fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass are changed; the tool returns the updated contact. Quoter API: PATCH /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: quoter_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items with name, code, SKU, category, manufacturer, supplier, prices and cost. Filter by name, code, SKU, category, manufacturer or supplier id. Quoter API: GET /items.

tools.name: quoter_get_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item by id, with its prices, cost, category, manufacturer and supplier. Quoter API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: quoter_list_categories
tools.description: List catalog categories, with their parent category. Filter by name or parent category id. Quoter API: GET /categories.

tools.name: quoter_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers that catalog items are bought from. Quoter API: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: quoter_list_manufacturers
tools.description: List manufacturers of catalog items. Quoter API: GET /manufacturers.

tools.name: quoter_list_item_groups
tools.description: List item groups, which bundle catalog items together. Quoter API: GET /item_groups.

tools.name: quoter_list_quote_templates
tools.description: List the quote templates that a new quote can be created from. Quoter API: GET /quote_templates.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "quoter_list_items" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: page, limit, name_contains, code, sku, category_id, manufacturer_id, supplier_id

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact · Private data: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_create_quote, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact, quoter_create_contact, quoter_update_contact · Public sink: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_create_quote, quoter_add_line_item, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact, quoter_create_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact · Private data: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_create_quote, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact, quoter_create_contact, quoter_update_contact · Public sink: quoter_list_quotes, quoter_create_quote, quoter_add_line_item, quoter_list_contacts, quoter_get_contact, quoter_create_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
